bullets.text: A youth died after accidentally falling into a drain in Madipakkam, and the office should monitor safety measures.
Around 800 ducks mysteriously died near Uthukottai in Thiruvallur, and officials must investigate potential disease outbreaks.
The Madras High Court disposed of cases regarding the Pallikaranai marsh construction ban, directing litigants to the Supreme Court.
Residents in Sholinganallur appealed in the High Court to protect one lakh families near the Pallikaranai Ramsar Zone.
The court issued a new order regarding the Pallikaranai wetland issue that the constituency team must track.
Heavy rain is expected tomorrow in Chennai and Thiruvallur districts, and the district team must stay alert.
Collector Kavitha announced the installation of 32 borewells under the 1,000-acre irrigation project in Thiruvallur.
Police arrested three people near Avadi in Thiruvallur for land grabbing worth two rupees crore using forged documents.
A new 400 MLD desalination plant is planned for Minjur to boost water security in Chennai.
Bodhan AI incubated at IIT Madras partnered to train over one million school teachers across India in artificial intelligence.
Vultr is expanding its India operations by establishing Chennai as a hub for network engineering and security.
The BJP released an AI-generated video featuring Sivaji Ganesan and Nagesh to mock the TVK cabinet ministers.
Stalin Duraimurugan was booked by St Thomas Mount police under three sections for defamatory remarks against TVK.
South Korean automotive firms Hwashin Automotive and Seoyon E-Hwa are investing Rs 1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu.
